source_winner.metric_signal: Winner-bank rank 121; 49670 likes, 161 comments, 346606 views_or_plays, winner_score 69046.21. Used as theme proof, not copied as final text.

source_engine.old_familiar_topic: Home is one specific person, not a place.
source_engine.first_frame_stop: A complete room with one person visibly not taking the other person's usual side.
source_engine.swipe_reason: The viewer wants to know whether the empty place stays ache or becomes comfort.
source_engine.send_or_save_trigger: Send to the person whose absence makes even home feel hollow.
source_engine.what_must_stay: The creator's first-slide lyric, the physical empty usual spot, and the ache that without the person even the speaker/home is empty.

novelty_model.new_reveal: The house is not empty because it lacks things; it is empty because one habitual place is still waiting for one person.
novelty_model.viewer_outcome: A viewer can send it because it admits the hollow feeling without over-explaining it.
novelty_model.contrast_frame: Generic version says 'home is a person'; this version proves it by showing the side nobody else gets to occupy.

urgency.reason: No fake timeliness is needed; the emotional window is missing someone.

novelty_model.bullseye_proof: One partner remains on their own side even when alone, leaving the other side untouched.
novelty_model.protect_the_illusion: Do not explain the moral. Let the kept place make the reader understand.

a_story_wrappers.what_changes_for_aachu_zuv: Aachu/Zuv become specific through an ordinary shared spot and the restraint of not occupying it.
a_story_wrappers.lived_scene_wrapper: One partner sits alone on the usual half of the shared sofa or bed; the other half remains open.
a_story_wrappers.visual_proof: The empty side is clean, uncreased, and respected.
a_story_wrappers.send_or_comment_trigger: People can tag their person with 'your side is still yours.'
a_story_wrappers.flat_or_generic_risk: If the room is just cozy and empty, it becomes a quote-card background. The body behavior must be visible.

a_story_wrappers.what_changes_for_aachu_zuv: Slide 2 becomes a private invitation, not a definition of love.
a_story_wrappers.lived_scene_wrapper: The missing person returns to the exact kept spot without a cinematic reunion.
a_story_wrappers.visual_proof: The same frame feels full because the specific body is back in the specific place.
a_story_wrappers.send_or_comment_trigger: The receiver feels welcomed, not demanded.
a_story_wrappers.flat_or_generic_risk: Over-polished wording would turn the note into a motivational quote.

anti_slop_risk.mitigation: Use a private, lowercase Hinglish note and a concrete kept-place visual.

candidates.rejection_reason: Strong alternate, but more cinematic and less directly tied to the empty-home physical receipt.
candidates.title: The Door Sound Changes The House

source_winner.metric_signal: Winner-bank rank 121; compatible home/person source engine.

source_engine.old_familiar_topic: The person makes the place home.
source_engine.first_frame_stop: A waiting body reacts to a door before the person enters.
source_engine.send_or_save_trigger: Send to someone whose arrival changes the atmosphere.

novelty_model.new_reveal: Home starts before the person fully enters; the body recognizes them first.
novelty_model.viewer_outcome: A viewer can send it as 'I know when it is you.'
novelty_model.contrast_frame: Not decor or address, but the arrival sound.
novelty_model.bullseye_proof: One partner looks up at the door in the half-second before arrival.
novelty_model.protect_the_illusion: Keep it quiet; no running, rain, or hug.

a_story_wrappers.what_changes_for_aachu_zuv: Aachu/Zuv recognize each other through a domestic arrival sound.
a_story_wrappers.lived_scene_wrapper: One partner sits in the room and softens before the other has entered.
a_story_wrappers.visual_proof: Eyes lift toward the door handle.
a_story_wrappers.send_or_comment_trigger: People comment with the sound that means their person is home.

anti_slop_risk.mitigation: Keep doorway composition simple and physically plausible.

candidates.rejection_reason: Very sendable, but less visually protected from quote-card drift than the kept usual side.
candidates.title: Bas Tum Nahi Ho

source_winner.metric_signal: Winner-bank rank 121; compatible home/person source engine.

source_engine.first_frame_stop: A complete room that feels too still.
source_engine.swipe_reason: The reader wants the missing-person proof.
source_engine.send_or_save_trigger: Painfully easy to send as a missing-you message.

novelty_model.new_reveal: The emptiness is not architectural; it is one-name specific.
novelty_model.viewer_outcome: A viewer can send the ache in one line.
novelty_model.contrast_frame: The room has things but not the person.
novelty_model.bullseye_proof: A normal room refuses to feel normal.
novelty_model.protect_the_illusion: Do not explain that home is a feeling.

a_story_wrappers.what_changes_for_aachu_zuv: Their absence, not the room, becomes the point.
a_story_wrappers.lived_scene_wrapper: One partner inside a familiar room that should feel complete.
a_story_wrappers.flat_or_generic_risk: Less specific than the kept-place idea.

anti_slop_risk.mitigation: Needs a more precise object, body position, or place to avoid becoming a flat quote.

selection.why: The selected idea is above threshold, keeps the creator's two-slide request, has the clearest physical proof, and carries both ache and comfort.

rejected_generic_versions: Lyric over an empty room followed by a polished explanation that home is a person.
A generic hug in a cozy room with no visual proof of why the house felt empty.
